title: #FitGang Bingo
description: A back-seat road-trip bingo game for spotting Honda Fits. Four randomized 4×4 cards on a single printable letter-size sheet. Honda shipped six near-identical blues, so they collapse into Light Blue and Dark Blue — Blue Raspberry survives on its own because it's actually a teal. Plus GD3/GE8/GK5 generation squares, a Free Space, and a Hot Rod wildcard. Spot it. Yell it. Mark it.

title: Cones
description: A second-generation clayground design system — React Aria Components + Tailwind CSS 4. Interactive Storybook with a full suite of UI primitives including forms, navigation, data display, overlays, and page-level patterns.

title: 5280 Design System
description: The 5280 Creative component library — a warm, human, faith-based branding system, presented as an interactive Storybook. Deep pine + jade anchored, with a lively red/periwinkle/gold accent set. Foundations (color, type, spacing) plus React components with live stories: pill buttons, navigation, forms with newsletter signup, cards, count-up stats, logo marquee, testimonials, accordions, tabs, modals, and toasts. Imported from Claude Design.

title: Tiny Prints — Print Queue
description: A 3-D print work-order tracker for Tiny Prints. Password-protected management dashboard with full CRUD, shareable public per-order links (no login needed), inline status updates, paid toggles, and Supabase or localStorage backend.

title: KC Live Timing
description: A mobile-friendly live timing viewer for KCRSCCA autocross and rallycross events. Drop in the axware results_live.htm file to instantly parse all class results, stream the 10 latest runs, sort drivers by fastest time, and build a personal competition watchlist with sticky 'my car' positioning.

title: Gearhead
description: The clayground design system — React Aria Components + Tailwind CSS. Interactive Storybook with all shared UI primitives.

title: Something's Happening
description: A real-time event timeline experience. Relive the Super Bowl LX 2026 streaker incident through fan footage, tweets, and media moments — playable like a social Shorts feed.
